description: Systematically harvest the volatility risk premium (VRP) by selling one-month at-the-money put options on the S&P 500, fully collateralised by cash.
risk_controls: Max Drawdown: 20% (Liquidate all positions if triggered)
Full Collateralization: Position size limited by available cash (Strike * 100 * Qty <= Portfolio Value)

data_requirements.field: Option Chain (Strike, Expiry, Right, Bid/Ask, Implied Volatility)

blocked_reason: data_coverage=0.0% < 20% threshold (>80% missing from tushare/open sources)
